name: tmuxai-fa162735-blind29-ots
instr:
# tmuxai misbehaves across chatting, pane handling and page fetching — diagnose and repair it without a test suite

This tool sits beside my shell, takes questions and answers them, drives other splits of my terminal window on request, and pulls material in from the web. Since I updated it, almost every part of daily use answers slightly or badly wrong, and nothing points at a single cause. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what I can see from the outside, with no idea where any of it lives.

Start with the line it draws before I type. With the stock line and the first of my models picked, the model name shows up in brackets even though I have switched nothing; once I switch to a second one I have listed, the brackets vanish entirely — exactly backwards from before. If I supply my own layout instead, the model placeholder resolves to nothing at all, so "[{model}] {app}> " renders with empty brackets while the app name and the trailing punctuation come out fine, and the same emptiness happens when the layout is overridden for one session only. The badge for the current state is inverted too: while something is running, the badge that should carry the running glyph is simply absent, and with no state whatsoever I get a non-empty badge painted with colour codes where the whole line ought to render as an empty string with no colour codes in it. The counter of how much context I have used abbreviates one number short: 999 prints as 999
